Absolute.description_en: false: relative position; the sentence position is determined in combination with the anchor and the role
Absolute.description_zh: false: 相对位置; 会结合anchor以及角色来决定句子位置

AllSentencesSatisfy.description_en: true: Every sentence must satisfy the condition;
AllSentencesSatisfy.description_zh: true: 每句话都必须满足条件；
AllSentencesSatisfy.title: true: 每句话都必须满足条件；

Cid.description_en: Condition ID, which may be the primary key in the database or a transformed identifier such as a, b, or c
Cid.description_zh: 条件id，可能是db中的主键，也可能是转换成的a, b, c
Cid.title: 条件id，可能是db中的主键，也可能是转换成的a, b, c

Rid.description_en: ID of the rule to which the condition belongs
Rid.title: 条件所属的规则id

Index.description_en: Flow branch priority. A smaller value indicates higher priority
Index.description_zh: 流程分支优先级。越小优先级越高
Index.title: 流程分支优先级。越小优先级越高

Lambda.description_en: Lambda expression for the next hop
Lambda.title: 通往下一跳的Lambda表达式

SayType.description_en: Indicates expression when the type is \`single\`
SayType.title: single类型时，是否表达

ScoreNumType.description_en: 0: Add or deduct points after the rule is triggered; 1: Score once after the rule is triggered
ScoreNumType.description_zh: 0：触发规则后加减分；1：触发规则后一次性得分
ScoreNumType.title: 0-触发规则后加减分;1-触发规则后一次性得分

ScoreRuleHitType.description_en: 0: Score when the node is hit
ScoreRuleHitType.title: 0-命中节点时计分

ScoreType.description_en: 1: Add points; 3: Deduct points; default is 1
ScoreType.title: 1加分 3减分 默认1

Rid.description_en: Rule ID. \`rid\` is empty if the rule is not persisted. If the rule is persisted, \`rid\` equals \`ID\`
Rid.description_zh: 规则ID，当规则没有落库时rid为空。当规则落库时rid==ID
Rid.title: 规则ID，当规则没有落库时 rid为空。当规则落库时 rid == id

UseConditions.description_en: Whether to use operator matching or legacy matching
UseConditions.description_zh: 是否使用算子匹配还是使用老板的匹配
UseConditions.title: 是否使用 算子匹配还是使用老板的匹配

FieldType.description_en: Field data source type: 1: System predefined field. 2: Quality inspection field for passed parameters
FieldType.description_zh: 字段数据来源类型：1：系统预定义字段 2：传参质检字段
FieldType.title: 字段数据来源类型：1：系统预定义字段 2：传参质检字段

Type.description_en: The matching relationship between conditions: currently all are OR relationships.
Type.description_zh: 条件之间的匹配关系：目前都是or的关系
Type.title: 条件之间的匹配关系 目前都是or的关系

Oid.description_en: The ID. This can be the primary key ID or an ID generated by the frontend
Oid.description_zh: 可能是主键ID，也可能是前端生成的ID
Oid.title: 可能是主键id，也可能是前端生成的id

Average.description_en: For speech rate detection: specifies whether to calculate the average speech rate for the entire dialogue. The default is \`false\`
Average.description_zh: 语速检测，是否计算整个对话平均语速，默认false
Average.title: 语速检测，是否计算整个对话平均语速，默认false

BeginType.description_en: For the duration operator: the start type for the duration calculation. The calculation can start from the beginning of the recording or the beginning of a specific sentence
BeginType.description_zh: 时长算子，时长计算开始类型，录音开始，还是某句对话开始
BeginType.title: 时长算子，时长计算开始类型，录音开始，还是某句对话开始

Case_sensitive.description_en: Specifies whether the matching is case-sensitive
Case_sensitive.title: 区分大小写

CheckFirstSentence.description_en: For silence detection: specifies whether to check the first sentence
CheckFirstSentence.description_zh: 静音检测：要不要检测第一句话
CheckFirstSentence.title: 静音检测：要不要检测第一句话

CheckType.description_en:
The detection method. The default is 1.

1: Energy fluctuation between contiguous sentences.

2: Maximum energy span
CheckType.description_zh:
检测方式：默认1
1：相邻句能量波动
2：最大能量跨度
CheckType.title: 检测方式，1 相邻句能量波动 2 最大能量跨度 默认1

CompareOperator.description_en: The comparison operator. Valid values are \`gt\` (greater than) and \`lt\` (less than)
CompareOperator.title: 大于，还是小于，gt/lt

ContextChatMatch.description_en: Specifies whether to match a single sentence
ContextChatMatch.title: 是否单句话匹配；

DelayTime.description_en: For the interruption operator: the delay duration
DelayTime.title: 抢话算子 延时时长

Different_role.description_en: Used for the time interval operator. If set to \`true\`, the target sentence is not included in the calculation if it is spoken by the same role as the current sentence
Different_role.description_zh: 用以时间间隔算子，判断时间间隔，为true则目标句子如果与本句是同一个角色说的话就不参与计算
Different_role.title: different_role

EndType.description_en: For the duration operator: the end type for the duration calculation. The calculation can end at the end of the recording or the end of a specific sentence
EndType.description_zh: 时长算子，时长计算结束类型，录音结束，还是某句对话结束
EndType.title: 时长算子，时长计算结束类型，录音结束，还是某句对话结束

Excludes.description_en: For the contextual repetition operator: the dialogues to exclude
Excludes.description_zh: 上下文重复算子：排除掉某些对话

items.description_en: For the contextual repetition operator: the dialogue to exclude
items.description_zh: 上下文重复算子：排除掉某些对话

Excludes.title: 上下文重复算子：排除掉某些对话

From.description_en: For the contextual repetition operator: checks for repetitions within the \`from\` number of sentences before the current sentence. A value of \`0\` indicates all preceding sentences
From.description_zh: 上下文重复算子：检测当前句的前from句是否有重复；0表示前面的所有句
From.title: 上下文重复算子：检测当前句的前from句是否有重复；0表示前面的所有句

From_end.description_en: Used for the time interval operator. Specifies whether to calculate the time interval by subtracting the end time of the target sentence from the end time of the current sentence
From_end.description_zh: 用于时间间隔算子，判断时间间隔，指定时间间隔的计算方式是否用本句的结束时间减目标句子的结束时间
From_end.title: from_end

Hit_time.description_en: For the contextual repetition operator: the number of repetitions
Hit_time.description_zh: 上下文重复算子：重复几次
Hit_time.title: 上下文重复算子：重复几次

In_sentence.description_en: The effective sentences. \`true\` indicates a single sentence. \`false\` indicates multiple sentences
In_sentence.description_zh: 生效句子，true单个句子，false多个句子
In_sentence.title: 生效句子， true单个句子，false多个句子

IntervalEnd.title: intervalEnd 代表区间范围结束

KnowledgeSentenceNum.description_en: The number of sentences after a question is hit within which to detect the answer
KnowledgeSentenceNum.description_zh: 命中问题后几句内检测答案
KnowledgeSentenceNum.title: 命中问题后几句内检测答案

KnowledgeTargetId.description_en: The knowledge category or knowledge ID
KnowledgeTargetId.title: 知识类目或者知识Id

KnowledgeTargetName.description_en: The name of the knowledge category or knowledge
KnowledgeTargetName.description_zh: 知识类目名字或知识名字
KnowledgeTargetName.title: 知识类目名字或知识名字

MaxEmotionChangeValue.description_en: The change in energy value. The default is 3. The range is 1 to 9
MaxEmotionChangeValue.title: 能量值变化，默认3, 1~9

MinWordSize.description_en: The minimum number of words in a sentence. Sentences with fewer words than this value are not checked
MinWordSize.description_zh: 句子中最少字数，小于此字数的句子不检查
MinWordSize.title: 句子中最少字数，小于此字数的句子不检查

Near_dialogue.description_en: \`true\` indicates that the two contiguous sentences from different roles are used. \`false\` indicates that the first sentence from each role is used to compare the response time. The default is \`false\`
Near_dialogue.description_zh: true表示取不同角色相邻的两句话，false表示取不同角色的第一句话比较响应时间（默认）
Near_dialogue.title: true表示取不同角色相邻的两句话，false表示取不同角色的第一句话比较响应时间（默认）

Pkey.description_en: The variable required for foreign-related properties
Pkey.title: 涉外属性需要的变量

RoleId.description_en: The role used in the operator. This parameter is currently used for the contextual repetition operator in conjunction with \`Target\_role\`
RoleId.description_zh: 算子中使用角色，目前用于上下文重复算子，与Target_role一起使用
RoleId.title: 算子中使用角色，目前用于上下文重复算子，与target_role一起使用。

Target.description_en: The target sentence, specified as the number of sentences before the current one. If set to 0, the time interval is calculated as the end time of the current sentence minus its start time
Target.description_zh: 目标句子是当前句子的前多少句，为0时间间隔等于本句的结束时间-本句的开始时间
Target.title: target

Target_role.description_en: Used for the repetition operator. If the current sentence matches the regular expression, the matched part is searched for in the sentences spoken by the specified \`Target\_role\` that appear before the current sentence
Target_role.description_zh: 用于判断重复算子，如果本句匹配上该正则表达式，那么匹配上的部份会在本句之前target_role指定的句子中查找
Target_role.title: target_role

UseEasAlgorithm.description_en: Specifies whether to use the EAS algorithm
UseEasAlgorithm.title: 使用eas算法

Velocity.description_en: Used for the speech rate operator. The speech rate value per unit of time. It determines whether the speech rate of the current sentence exceeds the specified value. The time unit depends on the time units of the \`start\` and \`end\` parameters
Velocity.description_zh: 用于语速判断算子。单位时间内的语速值，判断本句的语速是否超过指定值。时间单位取决于传入的start、end的时间单位
Velocity.title: 速度

VelocityInMint.description_en: Used for the speech rate operator. The speech rate value per minute. It determines whether the speech rate of the current sentence exceeds the specified value
VelocityInMint.description_zh: 用于语速判断算子。每分钟的语速值，用以判断本句的语速是否超过指定值
VelocityInMint.title: velocityInMint

QualityCheckType.description_en:
The quality check type:

0: Offline check

1: Real-time check
QualityCheckType.description_zh:
质检类型：
0：离线质检
1：实时质检
QualityCheckType.title: 质检类型：0 离线质检，1 实时质检

SkipWhenFirstSessionNodeMiss.description_en: Skip if the first session node is not hit
SkipWhenFirstSessionNodeMiss.description_zh: 首个对话节点未命中则跳过
SkipWhenFirstSessionNodeMiss.title: 首个对话节点未命中则跳过

KeyWords.description_en: Key information that was hit. This information appears highlighted on the review page. Examples include keywords matched by a keyword-check operator or category information matched by an agent-model-check operator
KeyWords.description_zh: 命中的关键信息，在复核页面上高亮展示的信息，例如关键词检查算子命中的关键词、客服模型检查算子命中的具体类别信息等

items.description_en: Key information that was hit. This information appears highlighted on the review page. Examples include keywords matched by a keyword-check operator or category information matched by an agent-model-check operator
items.description_zh: 命中的关键信息，在复核页面上高亮展示的信息，例如关键词检查算子命中的关键词、客服模型检查算子命中的具体类别信息等

From.description_en: Starting character position for highlighting. Index starts at 0. Maximum value is the total number of characters in the sentence minus 1. The character at position from is included in the highlight
From.description_zh: 需要高亮展示的关键字从第几个字符开始，取值范围从0开始，最大值为当句话字符总数减1。高亮的字包含from

OperatorKey.description_en: Key information matched by the operator

Pid.description_en: Index of this sentence in the full list of sentences. This is the index of the sentence in the dialogues array of the request parameters, starting from 0
Pid.description_zh: 当前句子在所有句子中的下标值，即当前句子是请求参数中dialogue数组中的第几个，从0开始

Tid.description_en: Internal use only. Ignore this field

To.description_en: The position of the character that follows the highlighted keyword. The character at the \`to\` position is not included in the highlight. For example, if \`from\` is 0 and \`to\` is 3, the highlighted keyword consists of the characters at indices 0, 1, and 2. The maximum value is one less than the total number of characters in the sentence
To.description_zh: 需要高亮展示的关键字到第几个字符结束，最大值为当句话字符总数减1。高亮的字不包含to，例如一句话为“不可能给你退货的”，from=0，to=3，那么需要高亮的关键字就是“不可能”三个字

Uuid.description_en: Internal use only. Ignore this field

Val.description_en: Key information matched by the operator. For details, see Detailed explanation of Val key information in the response parameter description below
Val.description_zh: 算子命中的关键信息，详见下方返回参数说明中的关键信息Val详解

Phrase.description_en: Sentence details for the current hit check item
Phrase.description_zh: 当前命中检测项的句子详情

Begin.description_en: Start time offset of this sentence relative to the start of the full dialogue, in milliseconds. For example, if the total audio duration is 2 minutes and 10 seconds, and a customer starts speaking at 1 minute and 12 seconds and finishes at 1 minute and 20 seconds, then begin equals 72000 and end equals 80000
Begin.description_zh: 这句话的开始时间相对对话整体开始时间的偏移量，毫秒级，例如录音总时长为2分10秒，客户的某一句话是在1分12秒时开始讲的，1分20秒时讲完，则begin的值为72000，end的值为80000

BeginTime.description_en: Start time of this sentence. Example: 2019-11-25 15:37:16

EmotionFineGrainedValue.description_en: Internal use only. Ignore this field

EmotionValue.description_en: Emotion intensity score. Value equals volume in decibels divided by 10. Valid range: [1, 10]. Higher values indicate stronger emotion
EmotionValue.description_zh: 情绪能量值，取值为音量分贝值/10。取值范围：[1，10]。值越高情绪越强烈

End.description_en: End time offset of this sentence relative to the start of the full dialogue, in milliseconds. For example, if the total audio duration is 2 minutes and 10 seconds, and a customer starts speaking at 1 minute and 12 seconds and finishes at 1 minute and 20 seconds, then begin equals 72000 and end equals 80000
End.description_zh: 这句话的开始时间相对对话整体开始时间的偏移量，毫秒级，例如录音总时长为2分10秒，客户的某一句话是在1分12秒时开始讲的，1分20秒时讲完，则begin的值为72000，end的值为80000

HitStatus.description_en:
Hit status. Valid values:

0: Not hit

1: Hit
HitStatus.description_zh:
命中状态。取值：

0：没有命中
1：命中

HourMinSec.description_en: Start time of this sentence in hh:mm:ss format
HourMinSec.description_zh: 这句话的时分秒格式的开始时间，格式：hh:mm:ss

Identity.description_en: Role identifier. In offline voice scenarios, roles are limited to agent or customer. In offline text quality check scenarios, this field shows the identity value passed in during upload
Identity.description_zh: 角色标识，离线语音场景下角色只有客服/客户，离线文本质检场景下，显示的是上传数据时传入的identity

Pid.description_en: Index of this sentence in the full list of sentences. This is the index of the sentence in the dialogues array of the request parameters, starting from 0
Pid.description_zh: 当前句子在所有句子中的下标值，即当前句子是请求参数中dialogue数组中的第几个，从0开始

RenterId.description_en: Internal use only. Ignore this field

Role.description_en: Speaker role for this sentence. Valid values: agent and customer
Role.description_zh: 本句的角色，取值：客服、客户

Sid.description_en: Internal use only. Ignore this field

SpeechRate.description_en: Average speech rate for this sentence, in words per minute
SpeechRate.description_zh: 本句的平均语速，单位：字数/分钟

Uuid.description_en: Internal use only. Ignore this field

ScoreNumType.description_zh: 计分类型，可能值：0（命中后加减分）；1（命中后一次性得分）

HitTaskFlowList.description_zh: 命中高级流程节点列表

items.description_zh: 命中高级流程节点信息

Message.description_zh: 出错时表示出错详情，成功时为successful

Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功，调用方可根据此字段来判断请求是否成功：true表示成功；false/null表示失败
Success.title_en: 请求是否成功，调用方可根据此字段来判断请求是否成功：true表示成功；false/null表示失败。
Success.title_zh: 请求是否成功，调用方可根据此字段来判断请求是否成功：true表示成功；false/null表示失败。
